levers.domain_notes: Sourcing: aerospace-metallurgy literature first — NASA technical reports, materials-science reviews, and manufacturer/engine-OEM technical publications outrank general web commentary. Evidence norms: measured figures win (specific service temperatures in °C, alloy compositions in wt%, creep/failure data); vendor marketing claims rank last. Recency window: underlying physical metallurgy is settled, but 'modern' means current-generation engines (~2010s onward), so confirm which alloys (e.g., third-generation single-crystal Ni superalloys, TiAl LPT blades) are actually flying today.
